name: Defines OS User
description: This host's own account database defines this account: the /etc/passwd entry or Windows local SAM account lives on the host. Containment: the account exists only as part of the host, so it retires when the host does (computing_core__host lists this edge in CONTAINMENT_EDGES). Exactly one per os_user, drawn to the host whose (realm, stable_id) the os_user's host_realm and host_stable_id name. A directory account (Active Directory, LDAP) the host merely resolves is not defined by it and draws no such edge.
